name: security-sqlite-extension-loading-review
intent: SQLite extension-loading authority in an embedded application
artifacts: Embedding runtime, extension-loading configuration, SQL entrypoints and process/file privileges.
trace: Determine whether lower-trust SQL or configuration can select an executable extension under the application process identity.
experiment: Use a local reviewed stub or source trace proving load reachability; never load an untrusted binary merely to validate a concern.
disproof: SQLite library presence or SQL input alone is insufficient if extension loading is disabled or inaccessible.
repair: Disable unneeded extension loading or constrain its trusted caller/source, preserving required embedded database operations.
branch_decisions: Distinguish native sqlite3 extension-loading enablement from SQL load_extension availability and the wrapper connection flags. Ordinary SQL injection does not automatically imply extension execution. The host must expose loading and a reachable library source; inspect the exact connection and use an inert local stub rather than loading an untrusted native binary.
